author: hicleanarch
name: CrowdFunding service host
description: A host of its own for one module: src/Services/<Module>.Host and tests/<Module>.Host.Tests, on the platform's service host builder. From the repository root: dotnet new install templates/service; dotnet new crowdfunding-service -n <Module> [--layout single] --port <port> -o . ; then add both projects to CrowdFunding.slnx and the image to CI.

layout.description: How the module is laid out: Domain, Application, Infrastructure and Contracts projects (layered), or one project (single, as Notifications).
